title: Table 12 — fases do turno de um Aventureiro, p. 100
scopeLimits: GET somente leitura confirmou zero traduções p. 100 e zero revisões p. 100; nenhuma tradução final foi escrita.
Este lote cobre somente o título externo da Tabela 12 e sua repetição no cabeçalho interno. As regras, símbolos, demais tabelas e a composição integral da página permanecem fora do recorte.
A expressão 'Turno do Aventureiro' segue a forma editorial usada nas referências do projeto; as propostas continuam pendentes de revisão humana e não são publicadas.

A comparação com o PDF oficial confirma que as duas caixas repetem 'Phases of an Adventurer's Turn', uma em 12 pt e outra em 8 pt branca sobre o cabeçalho escuro. Viewer e copyfit ainda requerem validação crítica.

Copyfit V3 was measured in the live PageRenderer for both title units at 100% and 200%. Each source PDF unit and each PT-BR rendering occupies exactly one visual line; original rich spans, font sizes, colors, and frame geometry were preserved. Both measurements are EXACT with no measured frame overflow.

The Viewer check was read-only and blocked every non-GET request. No final translation or human review record was written. Full-page neighboring-content review and exported-PDF parity remain pending; this title batch is not a claim that the whole page is complete.

copyfitMeasurement.method: scripts/measure_copyfit_page.mjs: PyMuPDF spans are first grouped by their source line object, then distinct source lines are grouped by representative baseline (1 pt tolerance). Rich runs in one line object remain one visual row. Inline uppercase callout markers and a separate Cinzel quantity glyph beside a declared weapon-hand symbol are folded into the adjacent prose row only when their ink boxes overlap. Live PT-BR PageRenderer text rects plus visible semantic-symbol rects for symbol-only rows are clustered by vertical centre (0.5 x median rect height); inline symbols overlapping a text row count with that row, not as extra lines. Candidate text and symbol IDs must match the selected renderer unit. For image-backed/raster-restored source text whose PDF extraction is incomplete, a candidate-scoped sourceVisualLineCountOverride may be used only with documented visual evidence. No character count, string newline count or frame-height estimate was used.
